WITH behavior_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind
),
pair_with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    transreg,
    tradekind,
    behavior_count,
    behavior_count::float / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () as share
  FROM behavior_pairs
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(behavior_count) as avg_count_per_pair,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_per_pair
FROM pair_with_share
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind;
